DRATA_API_KEY.description: Drata API key. Minted at Drata admin -> Company Settings -> API. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Scoped to the issuing workspace so no workspace ID is required. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

DRATA_API_URL.description: Drata API base URL. Default 'https://public-api.drata.com'. Override only for EU / dedicated tenants.

DRATA_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'tests'. Valid: tests (failing/needs-attention tests -> vulns), assets (monitored assets -> hosts), personnel (workforce inventory -> synthetic hosts).

DRATA_FRAMEWORK.description: Restrict tests to a Drata framework id or key (e.g. 'soc2', 'iso27001', 'hipaa', 'pci_dss'). Omit for all frameworks.

DRATA_PAGE_SIZE.description: Rows per API page. Default 100 (Drata max).

DRATA_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per mode. Default 50 (= 5k rows at the default page size).

DRATA_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor for failing tests. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

name: drata
title: Drata
description: Drata continuous-compliance import. Bearer API key, walks the public REST API (default https://public-api.drata.com/public/): failing / needs-attention tests become Faraday vulnerabilities tagged '[GRC]' on the affected assets (or a synthetic 'grc:drata:global' host if the test isn't scoped to one), monitored assets become Faraday hosts tagged 'grc:drata:asset-inventory', and personnel become synthetic workforce hosts. Set DRATA_FRAMEWORK=soc2|iso27001|hipaa|pci_dss to scope tests. Severity is normalised from Drata's enum into Faraday's info/low/medium/high/critical scheme; DRATA_MIN_SEVERITY drops rows below the floor. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent. Pagination via page/limit; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
